skills/cate-cli.description: Read this skill before the first `cate` command, the CLI on PATH in every Cate terminal (CATE_SOCKET and CATE_TOKEN are set) that drives the workspace the terminal belongs to. Use it whenever a task in a Cate terminal needs Cate itself, even if the person never mentions the CLI, such as looking at, testing or signing in to a web page in Cate's browser panel, taking a screenshot, reading or typing into another terminal, opening a file or panel for the person, starting other coding agents in their own panels or worktrees and waiting for their answers, or recording findings in a Review panel. skills/cate-theme.description: Author or edit a Cate IDE theme — one data-driven theme covering app chrome colors, the terminal ANSI palette, and Monaco editor syntax tokens. Use when the user asks to create, customize, recolor, or generate a Cate theme, mentions a color scheme (Dracula, Nord, "make Cate look like X"), or wants a new light/dark theme.
